name: WiredNYC – Participating Buildings
description:
This dataset lists buildings in New York City that participate in the WiredNYC program, which documents the broadband infrastructure and connectivity readiness of commercial properties. Each of the 206 sampled rows represents one building, identified by its BBL (borough-block-lot number), BIN, building name, street address, borough, postcode, and geographic coordinates, along with community board, community council, census tract, and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA).

The 30 columns describe each building's telecom characteristics: its certification class, the number of carriers serving it, and whether it has coax cable, fiber, or satellite/fixed wireless connections. Additional fields cover fiber distribution, multiple points of entry, designated and additional telecom space, riser space for current and additional providers, diverse riser locations, signed points of entry, agreements, and new service providers, plus two lists of internet service providers (isps_1 and isps_2).
